ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 3:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels across the visible ventral fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white field with low-intensity black mottling localized on the distal half of the left lobe; the central peduncle attachment and right lobe are primarily solid low-intensity black with sparse high-intensity speckling concentrated near the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 70 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-12 pixels; notable deep jagged indentations located on the medial-to-lateral transition of the left lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the superior edges of both lobes, terminating in acute, slightly tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-12 pixels in diameter) distributed sporadically across the central dark pigment and concentrated along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of several faint, unaligned light-grey linear disruptions (rake-like marks) visible in the lower central dark region, though partially obscured by water droplets.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant, irregular high-contrast mass consisting of reddish-brown and white pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe, indicating heavy crustacean colonization (barnacles).
other_distinctive_markers: Wide-field distribution of high-intensity specular highlights (water droplets) creating a granular pixel texture across the central dark regions of the fluke surface.
